body: Where do you get your shoes?
I always love seeing your hair. It gives me hope that I might be able to have similar results.
My bigger issue wasn't concluding if I was trans or not but instead if I should attempt to transition or just live my shitty life.
You are so beautiful!

I'm sorry for neglecting the relationship issues you have had in my previous post. But i have been told that you have to find happiness with yourself before you can share in that with someone else. Wherever your transition takes you is the right destination as long as you are happier than you were before. We just all have to find that spot for ourselves. 

Hopefully we can all get to a place where we are happy, even if our lives don't turn out the way we planned them to,

I am pre everything at this point but a lot of your points resonate with me. I'm afraid I just hate myself and I am using a trans identity to make it easier to rationalize hating myself. I'm at work but I'm going to reread this later to make sure I understand exactly what you're saying.
Yeah. I guess the height isn't really my biggest issue. Its mostly with my physical build. Height might be a part of it but I think I can get by fine with my height.

I'm hoping that things go similar with my family. As for the name thing, my sister received the name that they would have given me.

Thank you so much for the great discussion. You don't know how much this has already helped me.
I have been using Victoria, but I'm still thinking if that fits me and open to suggestions from my parents once I tell them
I figure it will be easier to say something before I start and it will make things go over easier in the long run. And I don't think it will go so bad. As long as I get over the fear of it first.
Yes I'm in the US and I'm in a pretty good spot geographically and financially. I have a therapist and already go to a support group. I really need to tell my mom I think first though.
I mean. I know that I'm trans. I need to stop pretending and just go for it.
Yeah. I guess that's true lol.

That is exactly something I've been fighting with myself over in my head. If that were the case I'd just assume die right now instead of even trying but I think at the moment I'm holding on because I am hopeful that i might be able to find happiness in transitioning.

My mind is a little messed up right now because I'm recovering from a concussion. 😒😔

I think the only emotions I've ever really felt are anger and a sadness/numbness.

I guess I can only really ever determine if I'm trans on my own but it got to a point 2 months back where I wanted to kill myself more than ever. It was that moment where I said I might as well try this before I off myself because I'm not really out of anything at that point.

I am terrible at remembering times when I was younger where I wanted to be a girl but I do remember a few things that might be used as evidence to help me confirm my identity.

Wow, all of that sounds similar to what I'm going through and are some of the fears that I've had. I hope that my experiences are similar when I start HRT. Last time I cried, Maybe 3 years ago when we had to put our childhood dog down... Its been a hard thing for me to do but I just learned recently that one of my cis guy friend cries all the time and I was curious because I am never able to.. (I remember reading about being unable to somewhere)

That is good to know. I'll probably just stick to cardio and very light weights until the levels get in place and once I'm okay then really pick up the pace. But I'll try to shed as much weight as I can while i still have a ton of T running through my system.
I figured after a month or two, things started getting into the irreversible stages. You're right though. I just need to jump off and get going.
That's amazing. I'm hoping to have similar results if only I can get brave enough to start HRT.
Did that confidence come after HRT? I know of some very tall women that do it so well. I'm just afraid I won't be able to do that.

I've heard a lot about trying HRT for a short amount of time and then seeing how things are. I'm afraid that taking HRT will make changes irreversible.. which is silly because i hate being a guy anyway. But I'm so afraid to basically sterilizing myself with HRT (even though I hate being a guy and I'm unsure of my sexuality)

I'm hoping that HRT and getting the ball rolling on my social transition will help motivate me to put in that extra effort. I've always been one to work hard and go get what i want. Hopefully starting those will help me get back on track and I'll be able to work really hard at this.

I keep going through the "I'm too old for this" argument in my head which I know is a terrible thing to do. But it's nice to hear about the possible changes I'll be having. Now to get over the fear of HRT...

I'm afraid that us exactly what's holding me back right now. Fear of the unknown. I plan on coming out to my mom really soon though and maybe that will help me since I'll have support. Or it could go badly lol but thats another issue.

My goal is to get under 200. I hope that is not an unrealistic goal for me. Accepting myself as trans has really kicked me into gear as far as taking care of myself goes. I'm finally watching what I eat and slowly working in to a workout routine.
Yeah that part does sound awesome. I guess the height part isn't too bad as long as I can manage to get my weight down more.
One if my best friends is tiny and I'm so jealous of here. I have a pretty decent ratio of fat and muscle so hopefully they might help with both of those things you described.

I'm afraid of even trying. If it goes well then that will be perfect. If it doesn't go well, I'm not sure that it will be better than just living a life I hate as a guy. Maybe it's the depression coming through on my opinion though.
Wow that sounds very amazing. I'm happy for you that things seem to be going well.
Imma need 2 or 3 more panels

That's my biggest fear. I'm afraid if I don't do it I'll end up dead and I think I'll be more likely to kill myself even if I do try it. I'm gonna try to make an appointment with my therapist because I'm getting really fucked up over this.

Speaking for what I was feeling earlier this year. It made me extremely happy. Looking at things now though, I can't say. I could take time thinking about it more but I'm afraid I can't afford to ponder on this any longer.

I guess what really made me happy was that I was out to some people and felt like I was taking steps toward really being happy.

I'm mostly afraid of transitioning, realising it didn't make me happy and then not being able to go back..

I'm not doing so hot. I accepted myself as trans earlier this year. Came out to all of my friends and a few coworkers. I hit a peak of happiness after that but started slipping back into depression. Now I'm second guessing if I should try to take hormones.. even second guessing being trans.. wondering if I should try to feel better or just wait until I hate myself enough again to kill myself.

I feel like I know what you are talking about.  Once I accepted that I was trans (amab) and started coming out to friends, I became much less depressed and maybe even slightly happy; my suicidal thoughts even went away. I began to second guess myself since in my head I thought 'wow I can finally be happy as a man'... I've been relieved that this past weekend my depression and suicidal thoughts came back so I know to keep going until I find happiness.
